sources: https://www.campspot.com/book/cadillacwoodscampground (availability API and site-type page, one and two nights from 2026-10-27, 2 adults)

values.note: The operator's site: RV sites (30-amp/water and 30/50-amp/water) start at $45 a night, rustic tent sites $25, cabins $75. On Campspot for Tue 2026-10-27: 30-amp/water site $47 a night, 30/50-amp/water $50; Campspot adds a $3 booking fee once per stay. Discounted monthly rate by phone.

fees.source: https://www.cadillacwoodsmi.com/policies ('30 AMP/Water and 30/50 AMP/Water RV Sites start at $45.00/night', (c) 2026) + https://www.campspot.com/book/cadillacwoodscampground (30 AMP/Water RV Site '$47.00 x 1 night | Booking Fee $3.00'; 30/50 AMP/Water RV Site $53.00 per night in the availability API, which folds in the $3 fee; 2026-10-27), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.cadillacwoodsmi.com/ ('30 AMP/Water and 30/50 AMP/Water options') + https://www.cadillacwoodsmi.com/policies ('Sites do not include sewer hookups. A dump station is available to all registered guests'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 34 RV and tent sites (27 with 30-amp/water or 30/50-amp/water, the rest rustic tent sites) plus 6 cabins. The operator says rigs to 42 ft; Campspot lists the 30-amp/water sites to 34 ft and the rustic sites to 30 ft.

sites.source: https://www.cadillacwoodsmi.com/ ('27 RV locations listed between 30 AMP/Water and 30/50 AMP/Water options', 'Stay options 40 ... 6 Lodging ... 34 RV Sites', 'Rig fit up to 42 feet', 'Back-in and pull-through options') + https://www.cadillacwoodsmi.com/stays ('Fits vehicles up to 42 feet long') + Campspot ('30 AMP/Water RV Site ... max 34 ft'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No public Wi-Fi reaches the sites (office Wi-Fi case by case). Portable honey-wagon pump-out for a fee.

facilities.source: https://www.cadillacwoodsmi.com/amenities ('Showers', 'General store / camp store', 'Dump station', 'Coin laundry room') + https://www.cadillacwoodsmi.com/policies ('Cadillac Woods does not have public WiFi that reaches the sites'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.cadillacwoodsmi.com/ ('Book through Campspot, or call the office'; Book Now -> campspot.com/book/cadillacwoodscampground), read 2026-10-22

note: Private wooded campground on M-115 in Tustin, SE of Cadillac; RV and rustic tent sites plus rental cabins, clubhouse, pool, mini-golf. Open May-Oct; nightly stays, and a discounted monthly rate by phone. --Claude
summary: Operator site (c) 2026 + Campspot: RV sites from $45 (Campspot $47 for 30-amp/water and $50 for 30/50 on 2026-10-27, plus a $3 per-stay booking fee); 50-amp, water, no sewer (confirmed; sewer false added); 34 RV/tent sites + 6 cabins (count 37 -> 34), rigs to 42 ft (max_rig_ft 30 -> 42), pull-throughs; showers, dump, coin laundry, store, no site Wi-Fi; Campspot booking. Season not stated by the operator or Campspot (no closed dates), left. Not seasonal in character (no seasonal sites offered; monthly rate by phone). Price gate: $45-47 base, under US$50.
